Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
457 PM EDT Fri Oct 9 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM LATE SATURDAY NIGHT THROUGH
SUNDAY EVENING...

.REST OF THIS AFTERNOON...SW winds 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TONIGHT...N winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft. 
.SAT...E winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.SAT NIGHT...E winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft.
Rain likely. 
.SUN...E winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft. Rain.
.SUN NIGHT...SE winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt...becoming SW
10 kt after midnight. Waves 3 ft... subsiding to 1 ft after
midnight. Showers.
.MON...NW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft. A chance of showers in
the morning. 
.TUE...SW winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming NW 15 to 20 kt after
midnight. Waves 1 to 2 ft.
